messages:
Nora (CSM): Heads-up — Zephyr Health just flagged a potential renewal risk unless we can run a late-evening hands-on. They said onboarding tasks are blocked on our tracing examples
Ethan (Enablement Eng): Late-evening as in 19:00-20:30 PT? That maps to 11:00-12:30 AEST for their EMEA/APAC leads?
Priya (Solutions): For clarity: Zephyr wants 90m interactive lab + 30m follow-up Q&A. Suggested dates Tue/Wed/Thu next week.
Nora (CSM): Correct. Their CSM noted adoption metrics dipped after the model switch — need a guided session on prompt templates + dedup caching tips. If we do this, it should reduce churn risk.
Marta (Zephyr): (joining thread) Confirming: Tue/Wed/Thu works; prefer Wed if possible. Thanks for trying to accommodate timezones 🙏
Ethan (Enablement Eng): I can host Wed 19:00 PT. I’ll need someone to handle calendar invites and the demo infra checklist.
Priya (Solutions): I can do Tue in case we need a backup. I’ll prepare a focused agenda and 3 short runbooks: onboarding checklist, cache tuning, rollout safety.
Nora (CSM): Great — volunteers: Ethan (host Wed), Priya (backup Tue). Who can send the calendar blocks and invite Zephyr reps? ops-bot: create event?
ops-bot: New meeting draft created: "Zephyr Health — Nightzone Hands-on" 2028-06-21 19:00 PT (90m). Link: https://cal.example.com/evt/ZX-9876
Ethan (Enablement Eng): Added the Zoom link and demo tokens to the event. Will include a short pre-read and a tiny repro repo.
Priya (Solutions): Agenda (short):
```
- 0-10: Welcome + goals
- 10-35: Guided prompt workshop (templates + evals)
- 35-65: Tracing + KV cache walkthrough (config snippets)
- 65-90: Q&A + next steps + follow-up tasks
```
Nora (CSM): Also capture feedback with the 3-question form after the session. I’ll add it to the calendar: 1) Was this actionable? 2) Any blockers left? 3) Renewal confidence (1-5)
Marta (Zephyr): That looks perfect. We'll share two engineers + product lead. Can you tag any prep items we should do on our side?
Ethan (Enablement Eng): Please provide a small sample dataset and the model config you used (quantization flags, seq length). If you can paste them into the calendar notes that's ideal.
Nora (CSM): I'll send a triage note to Zephyr and include the prep checklist. After the session we'll run a quick postmortem — capture enrollment + risk delta.
Priya (Solutions): Who will own the post-session follow-up? I can draft the follow-up playbook and assign blockers in Asana.
Nora (CSM): I’ll own follow-up and renewal signal update. Priya will own the playbook. Ethan will record the demo clips.
Marta (Zephyr): Thanks everyone — see you Wednesday. Appreciate the flexibility. :rocket:
Ethan (Enablement Eng): Thanks — I’ll post a short recording and the notes within 24h. :+1:
Nora (CSM): Closing loop: calendar invite sent, prep checklist in notes, backup Tue held by Priya. If anything changes ping me here.
